text:
Emily Chen: Heads-up — posted a PRD draft for multi-endpoint acceptance & launch gates. Need a quick sync on scope tradeoffs for chat/completions, embeddings, and rerank. Link: https://redwood.internal/prd/multi-endpoint-acceptance
Sanjay Patel: skimmed the draft. Main customer ask (Acme): embeddings must be deterministic for duplicate detection + 99.9% availability SLA. We should call out version pinning or a dedicated route for their traffic.
Alyssa Gomez: For determinism let's specify model+quantization+seed constraints. Proposed acceptance: cosine variance < 1e-6 for identical inputs across repeats given same model/config.
Marc Li: For rerank, acceptance should include top-3 stability under small prompt perturbations. Also requires a simple test harness and ~50 sample queries from CS to validate.
Nate O'Neal: Quick ops question — do we want to support streaming responses for rerank? Customer wants low-latency UI feedback. Streaming impacts runtime scheduling.
Emily Chen: We decided streaming for initial launch only for chat/completions. Rerank will be synchronous for v1. Note added to PRD — can revisit post-launch.
devops-bot: Reminder: spec review sync scheduled today 14:00 PT. Invite sent to thread attendees.
Sanjay Patel: Edge cases to call out: empty string -> defined embedding; very long inputs (>64k tokens) -> reject with 413. Suggested error payload: ```json
{ "error": "input_too_long", "status": 413, "code": "input_too_long" }
```
Alyssa Gomez: Also add acceptance for embed('') stability. Rate-limits: default 429 with Retry-After header. Need unit tests that assert Retry-After present and backlog handling.
Marc Li: API contract visibility: include model_version and quant_tag in responses so customers can reconcile results across rollouts. Example: `{"model_version":"v1.3","quant":"int8"}` in response metadata.
Nate O'Neal: Ops telemetry asks: include token_count + duration_ms per request for chat/completions; embeddings should return vector_size in telemetry for downstream cost analysis.
Emily Chen: Draft acceptance checklist (working): - API contract examples for chat/completions, embeddings, rerank - E2E smoke tests (50 queries per endpoint) - Regression evals showing quality delta < 1.5% vs baseline - Load tests to 2x expected QPS - Security review & KMS audit complete - Docs + SDK example snippets included
Sanjay Patel: I'll build the small harness for rerank stability tests. Will also add automated checks for rejection of oversized inputs.
Alyssa Gomez: I'll update PRD with determinism spec, error schemas, and add the unit tests for rate-limit behavior. I'll tag changes as `spec-v1.1`.
Emily Chen: :thumbsup: goal is to freeze scope by EOD tomorrow. If anyone has blocking customer constraints (latency, streaming needs, or privacy), flag them in this thread so we can escalate before freeze.
Marc Li: One more edge case — embeddings for non-UTF8 input. Contract should define normalization (NFC) and error handling.
Nate O'Neal: Noted. I'll add a quick checklist for normalization and add a smoke test for invalid bytes.
Emily Chen: Thanks all. We'll quickly review updates in the 14:00 sync and aim to merge spec-v1.1 after sign-off.
